def update(self, req, node_id, body):
    node_data = body.get('node')
    if node_data is None:
        raise exc.HTTPBadRequest(_("Malformed request data, missing"  
                                   'node' key in request body."))

    data = NodeData(node_data)
    # Check which fields are updatable and consider join/leave as node updates
    updatable_fields = ['name', 'profile_id', 'role', 'tags']
    if not all(field in updatable_fields for field in data.__dict__.keys()):
        raise exc.HTTPBadRequest(_("Invalid fields in node data."))

    self.rpc_client.node_update(req.context, node_id, data.name(),
                                data.profile_id(),
                                data.role(), data.tags())

    raise exc.HTTPAccepted()
